title: Heavenly Secrets Inheritance
next_chapter_hook: At the moment Chen Ji's fusion completed, a blurry image emerged in the depths of his consciousness—a woman's back, imprisoned within endless darkness.

text.content: The ink characters at the base of the ancient monument burned like branding irons, seared deeply into Chen Ji's soul. The faint script did not fade, but instead grew clearer the longer he gazed upon it—Next Heavenly Secrets Eye Candidate: Chen Ji. Seven characters, each weighing a thousand pounds, pressing down until he could barely breathe. The spiritual energy fluctuations around him fell eerily silent, as if the entire secret realm held its breath, awaiting his response.

Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. The Tianji Record fragment in his mind trembled violently, as if responding to the ancient monument's call. He distinctly felt a gentle yet irresistible force awakening from the depths of the fragment—that was the remnant soul's aura. The dormant remnant soul,沉睡 for a thousand years, had finally emerged on its own. "You've finally decided to see me." Chen Ji whispered in his heart, yet a knowing smile curved his lips. He had waited for this moment far too long.

dialogue.content: Old one, you hid deeply enough. If not for the ancient monument's coercion, how long did you intend to watch my笑话?

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's words fell, a ethereal white shadow slowly emerged from his brow center. It was an old man's phantom, with a blurred face yet transcendent aura, surrounded by starlight-like runes. He was the remnant soul left by the "Original Scribe" that Mo Xiansheng had mentioned, having slept within the first page of the Tianji Record for a millennium, and was now fully awakened.

dialogue.content: Joke? Even if you were a joke, could you deceive anyone? This old one merely waited, waited for you to reach this point yourself. Those chosen by the Tianji Record are never coincidental—it selects those who can carry this destiny.

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely gazing quietly at the remnant soul. The phantom slowly raised its hand, its illusory fingertip pointing at Chen Ji's brow center. A torrent of information instantly flooded into his Mental Sea—the remnant soul's lifetime of memories—regarding the origin of the Tianji Record, the fates of all generations of scribes, and the terrifying existence known as the "Heavenly Secrets Eye."

Memories surged like a tide. Chen Ji saw a white-robed man seated among the clouds, holding a yellowed scroll, gazing down upon all living beings. That was the original master of the Tianji Record—not some prodigy cultivator, but a mortal afflicted with an incurable disease, with little time left. He spent his entire life deducing the patterns of heaven's operation, and finally sealed all his knowledge into a bamboo scroll before his death.

Yet that mortal's original intention was never to become some destined scribe. From the moment of its birth, the Tianji Record was not created to pursue power, but was a key—a key to unlocking the shackles of the "Heavenly Secrets Eye." That mortal left these final words before death: "I used this book to peer into heavenly secrets, intending to break heaven's monopoly and restore all things' freedom."

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The remnant soul's phantom slowly unfurled a scroll before him, revealing within the painting a massive eye—the Heavenly Secrets Eye. It was not the title of some powerful being, but a will that towered above all living creatures, controlling everyone's destiny. And the Tianji Record was precisely the tool that generations of sages attempted to use to break this control.

dialogue.content: All previous scribes died from the Heavenly Secrets Eye's backlash. Yet they came one after another, only to pass the Tianji Record into the hands of those destined. This old one waited three thousand years, and finally found you—one unbound by heavenly fate.

text.content: The fusion process was far gentler than Chen Ji had imagined. The remnant soul's phantom gradually dissolved into starlight, sinking into his brow center. As that starlight flowed through his meridians, Chen Ji felt his body's acupoints open one by one, and bottlenecks that had been stagnant for years shattered with a thunderous crash. The barrier of late Deity Transformation stage was like thin ice meeting boiling water, instantly dissolved without trace.

However, just as the fusion was about to complete, a blurry image flashed through Chen Ji's consciousness—the back of a woman, imprisoned within endless darkness by countless chains. He recognized that silhouette. It was his sister, Chen Nian. In an instant, Chen Ji's gaze turned razor-sharp, and murderous intent nearly burst from his Mental Sea.

dialogue.content: What's the rush? The fusion isn't complete yet. If you cannot control your emotions, you will only harm her. This old one can only tell you—she is within the Heavenly Secrets Eye's cage, and that is also where the complete Tianji Record lies.

choice.prompt: The remnant soul's fusion was nearing completion, but Chen Ji faced a choice—accepting this inheritance meant assuming the mission of all previous scribes and becoming an enemy of the Heavenly Secrets Eye; rejecting it might preserve his self, but would cost him any chance of saving his sister.

choices.text: Accept the mission, inherit the legacy
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to accept the complete inheritance of the remnant soul, becoming the new scribe of the Tianji Record, and taking upon himself the unfinished mission of all previous sages—to break the Heavenly Secrets Eye's monopoly and liberate all beings controlled by fate.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the previous scribes' destiny and backlash
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete Tianji Record inheritance, break through to mid Deity Transformation stage, unseal the fourth layer abilities
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Secrets Eye's surveillance will become more frequent

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, allowing those starlights to fully merge into his soul. He felt the will of all previous scribes—their不甘, their执念, their hope. Now, this heavy burden had fallen upon his shoulders. "Chen Ji never retreats." He murmured quietly, his tone peaceful yet resolute.

choices.description: Chen Ji refused to be bound by destiny, attempting to resist this inheritance with his own will, preserving more autonomy. However, the remnant soul's fusion had become irreversible, and his resistance would only bring greater backlash.
choices.visible_cost: Suffer backlash during fusion, limited cultivation advancement
choices.visible_reward: Retain partial autonomous consciousness, retain the right to question the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Incomplete inheritance may lead to endless troubles

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his divine sense transforming into a blade, attempting to expel those starlights. Yet the remnant soul's power far exceeded his imagination—the two consciousnesses collided violently within his Mental Sea, causing agony almost enough to make him faint. "Well played, elder!" he ground through clenched teeth, yet did not abandon his resistance.

No matter what choice Chen Ji made, the fusion was ultimately completed. When the final wisp of starlight merged into his soul, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented sense of fullness. That was the unsealing method for the Tianji Record's fourth layer—a technique capable of briefly "shielding" the Heavenly Secrets Eye's gaze. During its effect, none of his actions would be perceived by the Heavenly Secrets Eye.

At the same time, Chen Ji's cultivation also achieved a breakthrough at this moment. The barrier of mid Deity Transformation stage shattered with a thunderous crash, and torrential spiritual energy flooded into his meridians like a tide. The surrounding secret realm space trembled violently, and countless spiritual energy vortexes formed around him—a terrifying sight. The aura of mid Deity Transformation stage rose steadily, ultimately stabilizing at a whole new height.

"Mid Deity Transformation stage, combined with the Tianji Record's fourth layer..." Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, feeling the surging power within his body. He discovered that his perceptual abilities had achieved a qualitative leap—what was once limited to foresight within three shichen now extended to twelve shichen. Moreover, the foresight visions had become much clearer as well.

However, just as the fusion completed, a blurry image flashed through the depths of Chen Ji's consciousness—a woman's back, imprisoned within endless darkness. Countless chains extended from within her body, connecting to a massive eye. That was the Heavenly Secrets Eye's true form, and also the location of the complete Tianji Record—his sister Chen Nian was waiting for him in that place.

Chen Ji rose to his feet, his gaze as sharp as a blade. "Chen Nian, wait for me." He silently vowed in his heart, "No matter what the Heavenly Secrets Eye is, I will rescue you." The ink characters on the ancient monument remained clear, but the Chen Ji of this moment was no longer the chess piece being pushed along by fate. He would take the initiative, placing his piece in heaven.
